story: Two brothers were invited to the underworld by its two ruling lords for a ballgame, and were defeated and killed. One brother's severed head was placed in a tree, where it spoke to a maiden passing by and impregnated her with its spittle. When she was found to be pregnant, her father and the lords of the underworld accused her of lying and ordered owl messengers to kill her and bring back her heart as proof. The owls spared her instead, presenting the lords with a fake heart made of tree sap. The maiden then fled to the upper world, to the home of the grandmother of the slain brothers, who set trials before accepting her, including gathering a full net of a grain crop from a garden containing only a single plant, which was accomplished with the help of guardian spirits. The maiden gave birth to twin sons, who were mistreated by their grandmother and jealous older half-brothers, until the twins tricked the half-brothers into climbing a tree that grew impossibly tall, transforming them into monkeys. The twins then defeated a boastful bird deity who falsely claimed to be a great celestial body, tricking him into losing his jeweled teeth and ornaments, causing his death from shame. They also destroyed his two arrogant sons, one by trapping him beneath a mountain, the other by poisoning and burying him. The twins later recovered their father's ballgame equipment, hidden by their grandmother, with help from a rat. Summoned to the underworld to play ball against its lords, they eventually defeated them, avenging their father and uncle. The twins turned their half-brothers into patrons of artists, and were themselves transformed into the sun and the moon.
